subject: general
question: The _______ dam is built across the Subarnarekha river.
solution:
The correct answer is__** Chandil.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **In the Jharkhand state Chandil, the hydropower scheme is on the Subarnarekha river in the Seraikela Kharsawan district.**
 
• The project is a tripartite initiative among the three eastern states, Jharkhand, West Bengal, and Odhisa.
 
• The main dam of the project is located at Chandil and another reservoir is located at Icha and two more barrages are located at Gauldih and Kharkiv.
 
• The main aim of the project is not only irrigation but also electricity generation for Jharkhand, West Bengal, and Odhisa.
 
• A loan of Rs 118 Crores for the construction of the project was sanctioned by the National Bank for Agricultural and Rural Development (NABARD).
 
• Initially, the World Bank from the USA (United States of America) sanctioned $127 Million but the funding was later withdrawn following the protest by the locals.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The Capital of Jharkhand is Ranchi which is also known as the city of waterfalls.**
 
• The current Chief Minister of Jharkhand is **Hemant Soren and the current Governor is Mr. Ramesh Bais. (August 2022).**
 
• **Chhau** is the classical dance of Jharkhand.
 
• The state is rich in mineral resources such as graphite, iron ore, limestone, coal, mica, etc and it accounts for 40% of the total mineral resources of India.
 
• The first planned industrial city in India is Jamshedpur in Jharkhand the city is the industrial capital of India and is known as the "**Pittsburg of India**".
 
• Dhanbad in Jharkhand is the coal capital of India.
 
• India's largest flag which is 493 feet high is in Ranchi and it is the tallest flagpole in India.
